dealSummary: Minneapolis-based Claros Technologies, which develops technology to eliminate chemicals from water and industrial waste, raised a $55 million Series B led by Treehouse Family Capital.
Fish Audio, the developer of an AI voice platform for text-to-speech, voice cloning and voice agents, raised a $52 million seed round led by Coreline Ventures and Capital Today.
New York-based ProphetX, the developer of a sports prediction platform, secured a $35 million round led by Parlay Capital and Data Point Capital.
Hush Security, an enterprise cybersecurity startup focused on identity management, raised a $30 million Series A from investors including Akamai, Battery Ventures and YL Ventures.
Salt Lake City-based Epitel, which develops AI-powered brain health monitoring technology, raised a $26 million Series B led by Catalyst Health Ventures and Genoa Ventures.
Zurich-based quantum computing startup ZuriQ secured a $25.5 million seed investment led by Quantonation.
Core Biomedicine, a biotech company developing oncology therapeutics, raised a $21 million Series A led by UTokyo Innovation Platform and Elikon Venture.
Array Labs, which builds satellite radar systems, received a $21 million investment from Mitsubishi Electric.
Bulgarian file data services company Tiger Technology raised a $10 million Series A led by 3TS Capital Partners.
